name: Full Feature Extractor
description: Computes heuristic promoter/RBS sequence features. If tss_best is absent, first ask once whether the user has an experimentally measured value for a matching construct context (integer offset from the promoter/RBS junction). Use it if supplied; if none, unknown, or the user wants to proceed, omit it and return sequence features without TSS-derived accessibility estimates. With a measured TSS, estimates Shine-Dalgarno and start-codon accessibility by ViennaRNA folding the inferred transcript through a provisional 90-nt sfGFP CDS context. Do not infer or invent a measured TSS, and do not repeat the question after it has been answered for this context.
